-- Append to the current AxiomGate source after importing RuntimeCoverage and ConfigContract.
-- These checks inspect its private policy rows without adding a public API. The target is the
-- configuration module (`Effect4.Program.Config`), whose `String`-side instantiations are exact
-- rendering admissions, public and private, beside theorems that stay at the base ceiling.
-- (Until 2026-10-01 the target was `Effect4.Codegen.EffectfulField`, retired in `f0591f36`.)

namespace Effect4.Program.Config

noncomputable def generatedSemanticChoiceProbe : Nat :=
  Classical.choice (show Nonempty Nat from ⟨17⟩)

end Effect4.Program.Config

namespace Test.Audit

open ProofGraph.Audit (moduleOf?)

/-- The configuration module's public rendering declarations, each admitted by its exact name. -/
private def configPublic : List Lean.Name :=
  [ ``Effect4.Program.Config.stdScalars
  , ``Effect4.Program.Config.segOfString
  , ``Effect4.Program.Config.splitUnderscore
  , ``Effect4.Program.Config.fromEnvRecord
  , ``Effect4.Program.Config.configCase
  , ``Effect4.Program.Config.segCase
  , ``Effect4.Program.Config.Provider.constantCase
  ]

/-- Its private ones, by the spelling they were written with. -/
private def configPrivate : List Lean.Name :=
  [ `Effect4.Program.Config.ce006Late
  , `Effect4.Program.Config.ce006Early
  , `Effect4.Program.Config.entriesOf
  ]

run_elab do
  let environment ← Lean.getEnv
  let auditModule := `Test.Audit.RuntimeCoverage
  let targetModule := `Effect4.Program.Config
  let mut failures : Array String := #[]
  unless auditImplementationModules.contains auditModule do
    failures := failures.push "RuntimeCoverage is missing its exact audit implementation admission"
  if choiceImplementationModules.contains targetModule then
    failures := failures.push "Config has a forbidden blanket module exemption"
  for name in configPublic do
    unless choiceImplementationDeclarations.contains name do
      failures := failures.push s!"rendering declaration missing exact admission: {name}"
  let mut auditNeedsChoice := false
  for (name, _) in environment.constants.toList do
    if moduleOf? environment name == some auditModule then
      let axioms ← collectAxioms name
      if axioms.contains ``Classical.choice then
        auditNeedsChoice := true
      unless axioms.all auditImplementationAxioms.contains do
        failures := failures.push s!"audit implementation exceeds its ceiling: {name}"
  unless auditNeedsChoice do
    failures := failures.push "RuntimeCoverage admission is stale or the actual module was not imported"
  unless failures.isEmpty do
    throwError "implementation boundary regression(s):\n{String.intercalate "\n" failures.toList}"
  logInfo "PASS exact audit module and public rendering admissions"

run_elab do
  let environment ← Lean.getEnv
  let declarations := environment.constants.toList.toArray.map Prod.fst
  let admitted ← match resolveChoiceImplementationDeclarations environment declarations with
    | .ok names => pure names
    | .error error => throwError "could not resolve exact implementation admissions: {error}"
  let targetModule := `Effect4.Program.Config
  let mut privateNames : Array Lean.Name := #[]
  for spelling in configPrivate do
    let owned := declarations.filter fun name =>
      moduleOf? environment name == some targetModule && privateToUserName name == spelling
    unless owned.size == 1 do
      throwError "expected exactly one owned {spelling} declaration, found {owned.size}"
    unless (choiceImplementationPrivateDeclarations.filter (· == (targetModule, spelling))).length == 1 do
      throwError "private rendering admission must name exactly its owning module and declaration spelling, exactly once: {spelling}"
    privateNames := privateNames.push owned[0]!
  let expected := configPublic ++ privateNames.toList
  let actual := admitted.filter fun name => moduleOf? environment name == some targetModule
  unless actual.length == expected.length &&
      expected.all actual.contains && actual.all expected.contains do
    throwError "Config implementation admission must contain exactly its {expected.length} rendering declarations, found {actual}"
  for name in expected do
    let axioms ← collectAxioms name
    unless axioms.contains ``Classical.choice do
      throwError "stale rendering admission no longer needs Classical.choice: {name}"
    unless axioms.all auditImplementationAxioms.contains do
      throwError "rendering admission exceeds its implementation ceiling: {name}"
  let firstPrivate := privateNames[0]!
  match resolveChoiceImplementationDeclarations environment
      (declarations.filter fun name => name != firstPrivate) with
  | .error _ => pure ()
  | .ok _ => throwError "missing private rendering declaration was silently admitted"
  match resolveChoiceImplementationDeclarations environment (declarations.push firstPrivate) with
  | .error _ => pure ()
  | .ok _ => throwError "duplicate private rendering declaration was silently admitted"
  -- every theorem the module declares stays out of the exemption and at the base ceiling
  let theorems := declarations.filter fun name =>
    moduleOf? environment name == some targetModule &&
      (match environment.find? name with | some (.thmInfo _) => true | _ => false)
  unless theorems.size > 0 do
    throwError "the configuration module declares no theorem; the semantic half of this check tests nothing"
  for name in theorems do
    if admitted.contains name ||
        (moduleOf? environment name).any choiceImplementationModules.contains then
      throwError "semantic declaration received an implementation exemption: {name}"
    unless (← collectAxioms name).all allowedAxioms.contains do
      throwError "semantic declaration exceeds the base ceiling: {name}"
  let planted := ``Effect4.Program.Config.generatedSemanticChoiceProbe
  unless (← collectAxioms planted).contains ``Classical.choice do
    throwError "the fresh semantic probe no longer tests Classical.choice"
  let plantedBound :=
    if (moduleOf? environment planted).any choiceImplementationModules.contains ||
        admitted.contains planted then
      auditImplementationAxioms
    else allowedAxioms
  unless !(← collectAxioms planted).all plantedBound.contains do
    throwError "fresh choice-bearing semantic helper received an implementation exemption"
  logInfo m!"PASS exact private resolution, rendering receipts, and base ceiling for {theorems.size} semantic declarations"
  logInfo "PASS fresh choice-bearing semantic helper exceeds its selected ceiling"

end Test.Audit
